analysis.title: 从模型竞速走向产品、算力与生态：本期 AI 趋势观察
analysis.lead: 本期共整理 130 条有效信号。下面不是新闻复述，而是把论文、公司、创业与政策放在同一张图里后的编辑性判断。
paragraphs: 研究侧共收录 20 条信号，重点包括 《BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored…》、《Reward Hacking Benchmark: Measuring Exploits in LLM Agents…》。与只看榜单相比，更值得持续观察的是论文能否把 Agent 的可靠性、评测完整性与推理成本一起向前推进。
AI 跨领域贡献收录 16 条，代表性事件包括 《Claude Fable 5 协助找到雅可比猜想的显式三维反例》、《OpenAI 模型推翻平面单位距离问题中的长期猜想》。这类结果会区分官方论文、可核验反例、媒体报道与尚待同行评审的社交平台首发，避免把‘可计算验证’和‘完成学术确认’混为一谈。
中国 AI 板块本期收录 16 条动态，已覆盖 Kimi / 月之暗面、DeepSeek。代表性变化包括 《DeepSeek Harnes 发布 v0.1.5版本》、《DeepSeek 静默改写路由层,替代了下架公告》；竞争正在从单次模型发布延伸到开源策略、Agent 产品入口、国产算力适配和价格体系。
产业侧共有 30 条前沿实验室与大厂动态、14 条关键人物公开信号，另有 12 条创业和 10 条政策安全更新。模型能力、算力供给、创始人判断、产品分发与合规成本正在变成同一个竞争问题。

items.title: BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored Co-Evolution
items.summary: BACE treats generated code and tests as co-evolving populations instead of accepting synthetic tests as ground truth. Bayesian belief updates model tests as noisy sensors, while public examples anchor the search and reduce self-validating drift. The authors report strong results on LiveCodeBench v6 across proprietary and open-weight models.

items.title: Reducing LLM Grading Inconsistency through Quality Dimension Refinement: A Measurement Theory Approach
items.summary: Automated grading systems are increasingly used in engineering education to manage instructor workload while providing timely feedback. Large Language Models (LLMs) have made this feasible for short-answer responses, but they exhibit grading inconsistency due to sampling variability: identical responses graded repeatedly can yield conflicting pass-fail outcomes in 8 to 20% of evaluations depending on question difficulty. This measurement error undermines the reliability of automated assessment.
